     3	import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.CharacteristicFunction.Basic
     4	
     5	open MeasureTheory Set

     7	/-- Removing the (at most countable) common discontinuity/atom set leaves the
     8	dense endpoint set used in the textbook interval argument. -/
     9	theorem dense_continuity_endpoints_of_countable (s₁ s₂ : Set ℝ)
    10	    (h₁ : s₁.Countable) (h₂ : s₂.Countable) : Dense (s₁ ∪ s₂)ᶜ := by
    11	  exact (h₁.union h₂).dense_compl ℝ
    12	
    13	/-- Equality on all half-lines determines a probability law.  This records the
    14	last measure-determination step of the textbook uniqueness proof. -/
    15	theorem probabilityMeasure_eq_of_Iic_eq
    16	    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    17	    (h : ∀ x, μ (Iic x) = ν (Iic x)) : μ = ν :=
    18	  thm_3_9 μ ν h
    19	
    20	/-- Atoms of a finite real measure form a countable set. -/
    21	noncomputable def measureAtoms (μ : Measure ℝ) : Set ℝ := {x | μ {x} ≠ 0}
    22	
    23	theorem countable_measureAtoms (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    24	    (measureAtoms μ).Countable := by
    25	  have h := countable_meas_level_set_pos (μ := μ) (g := fun x : ℝ ↦ x) measurable_id
    26	  simpa [measureAtoms, pos_iff_ne_zero] using h
    27	
    28	theorem dense_common_nonatom_endpoints (μ ν : Measure ℝ)
    29	    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    30	    Dense (measureAtoms μ ∪ measureAtoms ν)ᶜ :=
    31	  dense_continuity_endpoints_of_countable _ _ (countable_measureAtoms μ)
    32	    (countable_measureAtoms ν)
    33	
    34	/-- The inversion formula makes the two laws agree on every open interval whose
    35	endpoints are non-atoms of both laws. -/
    36	theorem inversion_interval_eq_of_charFun_eq
    37	    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    38	    (h : ∀ t : ℝ, characteristicFunction μ t = characteristicFunction ν t)
    39	    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    40	    (haμ : a ∉ measureAtoms μ) (hbμ : b ∉ measureAtoms μ)
    41	    (haν : a ∉ measureAtoms ν) (hbν : b ∉ measureAtoms ν) :
    42	    μ.real (Ioo a b) = ν.real (Ioo a b) := by
    43	  have hma : μ {a} = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp haμ
    44	  have hmb : μ {b} = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hbμ
    45	  have hna : ν {a} = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp haν
    46	  have hnb : ν {b} = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hbν
    47	  let Fμ : ℝ → ℂ := fun T ↦ (2 * Real.pi : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∫ t in -T..T,
    48	    ((Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * (a : ℂ) * Complex.I) -
    49	      Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * (b : ℂ) * Complex.I)) / ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
    50	      characteristicFunction μ t)
    51	  let Fν : ℝ → ℂ := fun T ↦ (2 * Real.pi : ℂ)⁻¹ * (∫ t in -T..T,
    52	    ((Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * (a : ℂ) * Complex.I) -
    53	      Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) * (b : ℂ) * Complex.I)) / ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
    54	      characteristicFunction ν t)
    55	  have heq : Fμ = Fν := by
    56	    funext T
    57	    unfold Fμ Fν
    58	    congr 2
    59	    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    60	    intro t _
    61	    rw [h t]
    62	  have hm := CharacteristicFunctionInversion.thm_9_5_normalized μ hab
    63	  have hn := CharacteristicFunctionInversion.thm_9_5_normalized ν hab
    64	  change Tendsto Fμ atTop (nhds ((μ.real (Ioo a b) : ℝ) : ℂ)) at hm
    65	  · simp [hma, hmb] at hm
    66	  change Tendsto Fν atTop (nhds ((ν.real (Ioo a b) : ℝ) : ℂ)) at hn
    67	  · simp [hna, hnb] at hn
    68	  rw [heq] at hm
    69	  exact_mod_cast tendsto_nhds_unique hm hn
    70	
    71	/-- The characteristic function uniquely determines a finite real measure. -/
    72	theorem thm_9_6_law (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    73	    (h : ∀ t : ℝ, characteristicFunction μ t = characteristicFunction ν t) : μ = ν := by
    74	  apply Measure.ext_of_charFun
    75	  funext t
    76	  exact h t
    77	
    78	/-- Textbook Theorem 9.6 for random variables: equality of characteristic
    79	functions implies equality of push-forward laws. -/
    80	theorem thm_9_6
    81	    {Ω Ω' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    82	    (P : Measure Ω) (Q : Measure Ω') [IsProbabilityMeasure P] [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    83	    (X : Ω → ℝ) (Y : Ω' → ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X P) (hY : AEMeasurable Y Q)
    84	    (h : ∀ t : ℝ,
    85	      characteristicFunction (P.map X) t = characteristicFunction (Q.map Y) t) :
    86	    P.map X = Q.map Y := by
    87	  exact thm_9_6_law (P.map X) (Q.map Y) h

+/-- The exact source assumptions for the second sensor: only zero mean and variance are used. -/
+theorem twoSensorAffineMSE_eq_quadratic_source {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
+    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X N₁ N₂ : Ω → ℝ}
+    {μ σ₀sq σ₂sq : ℝ} {σ₁sq : NNReal}
+    (hX : MemLp X 2 P) (hmean : (∫ ω, X ω ∂P) = μ)
+    (hvar : Var[X; P] = σ₀sq)
+    (hN₁ : HasLaw N₁ (gaussianReal 0 σ₁sq) P)
+    (hN₂ : MemLp N₂ 2 P) (hN₂mean : (∫ ω, N₂ ω ∂P) = 0)
+    (hN₂var : Var[N₂; P] = σ₂sq)
+    (hi : iIndepFun ![X, N₁, N₂] P) :
+    ∀ a b, twoSensorAffineMSE P X N₁ N₂ μ a b =
+      (1 - a - b) ^ 2 * σ₀sq + a ^ 2 * (σ₁sq : ℝ) + b ^ 2 * σ₂sq := by
+  obtain ⟨h1, hm1, hv1⟩ := gaussian_noise_moments hN₁
+  have h2sq : (∫ ω, N₂ ω ^ 2 ∂P) = σ₂sq := by
+    calc
+      (∫ ω, N₂ ω ^ 2 ∂P) = ∫ ω, (N₂ ω - ∫ x, N₂ x ∂P) ^ 2 ∂P := by
+        rw [hN₂mean]
+        simp
+      _ = Var[N₂; P] := (variance_eq_integral hN₂.aemeasurable).symm
+      _ = σ₂sq := hN₂var
+  have hi01 : IndepFun X N₁ P := by
+    simpa using hi.indepFun (i := (0 : Fin 3)) (j := (1 : Fin 3)) (by decide)
+  obtain ⟨hS, hSsq, _⟩ := centered_source_facts hX hmean hvar hi01
+  have hiS := centered_three_independent μ hi
+  intro a b
+  rw [twoSensorAffineMSE_eq_centered,
+    twoSensorMSE_eq_quadratic a b hS h1 hN₂ hiS hm1 hN₂mean, hSsq, hv1, h2sq]
+
+/-- Exact textbook two-sensor result for a positive denominator. `N₂` need not be Gaussian. -/
+theorem prob_12_5_two_source_affine {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
+    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X N₁ N₂ : Ω → ℝ}
+    {μ σ₀sq σ₂sq : ℝ} {σ₁sq : NNReal}
+    (hX : MemLp X 2 P) (hmean : (∫ ω, X ω ∂P) = μ)
+    (hvar : Var[X; P] = σ₀sq)
+    (hN₁ : HasLaw N₁ (gaussianReal 0 σ₁sq) P)
+    (hN₂ : MemLp N₂ 2 P) (hN₂mean : (∫ ω, N₂ ω ∂P) = 0)
+    (hN₂var : Var[N₂; P] = σ₂sq)
+    (hi : iIndepFun ![X, N₁, N₂] P)
+    (hden : 0 < σ₀sq * (σ₁sq : ℝ) + σ₀sq * σ₂sq + (σ₁sq : ℝ) * σ₂sq) :
+    (∀ a b, twoSensorAffineMSE P X N₁ N₂ μ a b =
+      (1 - a - b) ^ 2 * σ₀sq + a ^ 2 * (σ₁sq : ℝ) + b ^ 2 * σ₂sq) ∧
+    (∀ a b, twoSensorAffineMSE P X N₁ N₂ μ
+        (σ₀sq * σ₂sq /

+        (σ₀sq * (σ₁sq : ℝ) /

+      twoSensorAffineMSE P X N₁ N₂ μ a b) := by

+  exact twoSensorMSE_optimal P (fun ω => X ω - μ) N₁ N₂ σ₀sq
+    (σ₁sq : ℝ) σ₂sq hs0 σ₁sq.coe_nonneg hs2
+    (fun u v => (twoSensorAffineMSE_eq_centered P X N₁ N₂ μ u v).symm.trans (hq u v))
+    hden a b
+

+    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X N₁ N₂ : Ω → ℝ}
+    {μ σ₀sq σ₂sq : ℝ} {σ₁sq : NNReal}
+    (hX : MemLp X 2 P) (hmean : (∫ ω, X ω ∂P) = μ)
+    (hvar : Var[X; P] = σ₀sq)
+    (hN₁ : HasLaw N₁ (gaussianReal 0 σ₁sq) P)
+    (hN₂ : MemLp N₂ 2 P) (hN₂mean : (∫ ω, N₂ ω ∂P) = 0)
+    (hN₂var : Var[N₂; P] = σ₂sq)
+    (hi : iIndepFun ![X, N₁, N₂] P)
+    (hz : σ₀sq * (σ₁sq : ℝ) + σ₀sq * σ₂sq + (σ₁sq : ℝ) * σ₂sq = 0) :

+  have hs2 : 0 ≤ σ₂sq := hN₂var ▸ variance_nonneg N₂ P
+  have hzero := twoSensorAffineMSE_degenerate P X N₁ N₂ μ σ₀sq
+    (σ₁sq : ℝ) σ₂sq hs0 σ₁sq.coe_nonneg hs2 hq hz
